decision: At the first completed 70-request main-model boundary, strictly validate every raw record and prior ledger. Forecast that measured model's task share at the unchanged matrix allowances with at least 20% reserve. If this priced subset already exceeds a protective ceiling, stop the remaining optional cost calibration and report RESOURCE_BLOCKED before M1/G1 or scientific experiments.
unpriced_costs: Other model stages, all proposer/cold/pilot/failure costs are explicitly unpriced, not estimates of zero. A small or feasible subset never approves G0.
limitations: This resource decision is based on preformal cost observations, not method scores or blinded research preregistration. Sample means/reserve are planning assumptions, not certified lower bounds. Legitimate early stopping and alternate execution protocols can change future actual costs.
